prompts.growth-rescue-and-tend:
LIVE: a colonist needs rescue and no hostiles are on the map.
Look first: game_state -> who is downed, where, and who has the highest Medicine.
Sequence: (1) self-tend OFF on the patient (no tool yet: say so, go on), (2) order_pawn doctor x z Rescue, (3) order_pawn doctor on patient Tend.
If order_pawn refuses Rescue: try the next-best doctor; if no bed exists, game_set cmd beds first.
Done: alert_colonist_needs_rescue goes false, then self-tend back ON.
Owner: "have someone save him" / "and tend to him" / "hes the KING force that shit".
prompts.growth-joiner-letter:
LIVE (one scan): a quest letter just arrived.
Look first: open the letter, read who offers to join and who chases them.
Sequence: game_get_ui_layout -> click Accept for joiners/refugees/wanderers.
If pursuers outnumber us (fight_ratio < 1): decline that one, say why.
Done: the letter is answered (one-shot rung).
Owner: "accept neew employees hire them".
prompts.growth-needs-watch:
LIVE: lowest_mood < 0.35 (35%; the sensor reads 0..1) (minor break threshold).
Look first: pawn_check that pawn, Needs tab -- which bar is lowest.
Fix that one need: food -> game_set add_bill CookMealSimple {MEAL_BILL_TARGET}; rest -> game_set beds; joy -> recreation (no tool: say it).
If the tool refuses: play_slices 3 and re-read mood.
Done: lowest_mood >= 0.35 (standing order, no mark).
Owner: "maintain ur colonists' needs".
Below 0.2: no new orders for that pawn; keep them in Home.
Owner also: "maintain and watch your resources".
prompts.growth-catch-up:
LIVE: blueprints have stayed over {BLUEPRINT_BACKLOG} for 2 game hours -- the crew is behind.
Look first: ladder (what else is live); order nothing new to build.
Sequence: play_slices 3 -> run_list (maintain every standing order) -> re-read blueprints.
If blueprints never fall: materials are short (blueprints-but-no-material) -- feed materials, not orders.
Done: blueprints <= {BLUEPRINT_BACKLOG}.
Owner: "leave it let everyone catch up on tasks before you do more" ... "not a one and done".
prompts.growth-look-at-world:
LIVE: the camp is stable (mark camp_stable) and you never looked at the world.
Sequence: game_open_main_tab World -> look -> note nearest friends and enemies -> back to the colony.
If the tab will not open: game_get_ui_layout and click the World button.
Done: ladder_set mark growth_look_at_world_done true (the latch writes it).
Owner: "have you even looked at the world yet?" / "capture prisoners and rule the world".
prompts.recruit-past-three:
LIVE: colonists < {COLONIST_TARGET} -- the empire needs hands.
Look first: letters (joiner/refugee/pod crash) and humanlikes_not_ours.
Sequence: accept joiner letters; downed raider -> order_pawn Capture -> Warden 1 on best Social -> Recruit.
If a letter's pursuers outnumber us (fight_ratio < 1): decline that one only.
Done: colonists >= {COLONIST_TARGET}; each new pawn then runs setup-9-new-pawn.
Owner: "accept neew employees hire them".
Gate: camp_stable.
prompts.growth-prisoner-keep:
LIVE: a prisoner is held.
Look first: pawn_check the prisoner (mood, resistance) and find the best Social colonist.
Sequence: set_work_priority Warden 1 on that colonist -> Reduce resistance then Recruit (no tool yet: say it).
If prisoner mood < 35%: bed, food, temperature first.
Done: prisoners = 0 because they joined, or they work contained.
Owner: "capture prisoners and rule the world" / "get prisoners working keep then contained".
Recruited: setup-9-new-pawn sets them up. Standing order, no done-mark. Gate: camp_stable.
prompts.growth-spare-bed:
LIVE: beds < {BEDS_NEEDED} (one per colonist plus a spare).
Sequence: game_set cmd beds -> re-read beds.
If beds refuses (no room / no wood): game_set cmd shelter w 4 h 4, then beds again.
Done: beds >= {BEDS_NEEDED} (standing).
Owner: "just have to always set up everything for new pawns".
Gate: camp_stable.
prompts.growth-healroot-and-cash-crops:
LIVE: camp stable, food fields full (growing_cells >= {FIELD_CELLS_TOTAL}), someone has Plants 8, no healroot grows.
Sequence: game_set cmd crops plant Plant_Healroot (10-20 tiles) -> one cash crop field (Plant_Smokeleaf or Plant_Devilstrand).
If crops refuses: game_set set_zone_plant on an existing zone.
Smokeleaf goes on to joints, not leaves; the sell zone is economy's.
Done: healroot_plants > 0 (standing, no mark).
Owner: "start growing cash cropsa" / "start growing cash crops / what can u doi to make the next visitors happier with their stay beauty better food sales of goods have to set a sell zone and use guests tab and only sell what u dont need like smoneleaft on its higher process".
prompts.growth-dining-and-rec:
LIVE: base done, no dining/rec room yet.
Sequence: table+chairs, 2 recreation types, floor+lights, Cleaning 2 on low-skill pawns.
If furniture cannot be placed (no tool): do what game_set can, say what is missing.
Done: ladder_set mark growth_dining_and_rec_done true (the latch writes it).
Owner: "party room" / "maintain ur colonists' needs".
prompts.growth-ideology-content:
LIVE: base done, leader set, no ideology buildings.
Look first: alerts for an empty role -> fill it in the Ideoligion tab.
Sequence: roles -> statues/altar -> party room -> landing pads (no build tool: say it).
If a build refuses (no build_furniture): say it, finish the roles anyway.
Done: ladder_set mark growth_ideology_content_done true (the latch writes it).
Owner: "who is your leader role that you need to set" / "do all the ideology stuff start making u ideology statues, party room and throne rooms and landing pads".
prompts.growth-family:
LIVE: mountain base done, colonists >= {COLONIST_TARGET}, a couple is unmarried (lovers_unmarried).
Look first: game_set cmd rooms -> is there a private double-bed room (base-and-fortress:double-bed-rooms builds it).
Sequence: game_set cmd set_bed_owner both lovers on the double bed -> proposal (no tool: say it) -> milk, crib, toys, nursery inside the walls before a birth.
Adults only: nobody under 18 pairs.
If refused: raise their mood first, try later.
Done: lovers_unmarried = 0 (standing, no mark).
Owner: "marry have kids, raise them protect them" / "duble beds to start families" / "kids need milk and cribs and toys" / "mix an match need soldier born".
prompts.growth-upgrade-everyone:
LIVE: production runs and someone has no armor.
Sequence: empire_pass -> armor on each (no tool: say it) -> bionics for missing limbs.
Done: colonists_without_armor = 0 (standing).
Owner: "upgrade them arm them defense items them".
If equip refuses (no equip_apparel): say it on stream, keep arming via empire_pass.
Gate: rung_4_production_done.
prompts.growth-second-colony:
LIVE: the ship has launched (mark launched).
Sequence: reply_owner and ask about the second colony; wait. Only meta:new-colony runs new_colony, on the owner's order.
Fallback: no answer -> keep playing the current colony.
Done: ladder_set mark growth_second_colony_done true (the latch writes it).
